$comment: Single source of truth. Humans only (agent hook + CODEOWNERS). Every change requires an accepted ADR.

packages/domain.role: Pure business rules and value objects (Money etc.). No I/O.

packages/contracts.role: API input/output Zod schemas. Validation rules live only here.

packages/core.role: Use cases (actions/queries). Knows nothing about HTTP or queues.

apps/api.role: Hono HTTP layer: validation + core calls. No business rules.

apps/worker.role: pg-boss background jobs: core calls only. No business rules.

apps/web.role: React SPA. Talks to the API only through the hc<AppType> client.

deferred.name: auth
deferred.trigger: When real user sign-in becomes a requirement (preferred: better-auth).

deferred.name: i18n
deferred.trigger: When a second UI language is requested.

deferred.name: ui
deferred.trigger: When a second app needs the same components.

deferred.name: config
deferred.trigger: When the same env schema is duplicated in a third app.

deferred.name: integrations
deferred.trigger: When the first third-party API integration is approved.

deferred.name: crawler
deferred.trigger: When a data need that the official API cannot cover (ToS) is approved.

deferred.name: e2e
deferred.trigger: When the first critical user flow is complete.

deferred.name: redis-queue
deferred.trigger: When pg-boss hits a measured throughput limit.

claude_md_block.$comment: The scaffold block in CLAUDE.md is protected; everything outside it is free. If a human changes the block, update sha256 (__RUN__ arch --claude-hash).
